title: Rory and the Crystal River Cave
verses:
As the moon rose up high over mountain and hill,
Soft Nia swooped down through the cool evening air.
The forest below was contented and still,
And chirpy Psittaco chirped softly right there.

Big Benny walked slow to a clear crystal stream,
Where gentle green Rory stepped softly beside.
The water was bright with a silvery gleam,
Expanding so quiet and peaceful and wide.

They found a grand cavern of velvet and moss,
With sands that were warm for a sleepy repose.
A bridge made of ivy was stretched right across,
Where shadows fell soft as the night gently rose.

Sweet Tilly settled down on a cushion of fern,
And rested her neck as she let out a sigh.
Strong Ricky lay close for his comfy cozy turn,
With chin on his paw as the breeze whispered by.

Psittaco nested deep in a soft leafy bed,
While Nia perched high on a rocky stone ledge.
A blanket of stars shone above every head,
Adorning the sky from the ridge to the edge.

Kind Rory let out a soft yawn in the dark,
And snuggled up warm with his friends for the night.
The cave held a shimmering, silvery spark,
To wrap them in dreams till the morning's bright light.
